items.title: Why High-Yield Baby Bonds Offer Income Investors a Rare Opportunity
items.summary: Have a look at an obscure corner of the corporate bond market that is offering high yields and good credit quality.  In fact, yields on the babies are near their highest levels in more than 15 years, and they offer rates that are comparable to junk bonds, but with higher credit quality.  One nice feature of Baby Bonds is that they trade like stocks on the NYSE or Nasdaq.
